# Character enrichment sources

These optional, unreviewed annotations were supplied in the character-enrichment
handoff. The original canonical catalogue remains separate and unchanged.

- Make Me a Hanzi dictionary, commit bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92:
  LGPL-3.0-or-later. Corresponding dictionary source and licence notices are in
  `notices/`. Source: https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi/tree/bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92
- Hanzi Writer Data 2.0.1: Arphic Public License. Geometry is fetched on demand
  from the version-pinned package, not replaced by standalone components.
  Notice: `notices/STROKE_DATA_ARPHICPL.txt`.
- BabelStone IDS, 2025-06-27 / Unicode 16.0: source comparisons retain their
  regional qualifiers. The supplied manifest records permission evidence, not
  an independently established licence for all underlying characters. No full
  BabelStone snapshot is redistributed here. Source: https://www.babelstone.co.uk/CJK/IDS.TXT
- GF 0014-2009: eight bounded textual rule-example annotations only. No PDF,
  font artwork, table artwork or complete standard component inventory is
  redistributed. Source: https://www.unicode.org/irg/docs/n2739-GF0014-2009.pdf

`manifest.json` retains the supplied source versions, hashes, consumer policy,
licence-notice references and coverage. Original generator/audit utilities and
all their inputs were not provided; the local split adapter is not a substitute
for rerunning that upstream audit. Exact source agreement and complete stroke
coverage do not establish editorial approval, etymology or verified stroke names.

entries.text: As per 冓# (symmetry) + 手 hand/action indicator → *assemble* a construction → *put together* → *occur one after another*; *create an intricate situation*.
動搈也。从手容聲。
敲擊也。从手隺聲。
As per 員# (round) + 手 hand/action indicator → make a round hole in damaging an object → *loss*; *harm*; *damage*; *ruin* → *decrease*; *sink*; *hollow*; *humble oneself*; *fail*; *miss*.
減也。从手員聲。

As per 尃# as described in 博 (spread) + 手 hand/action indicator → spread the hand in slapping/striking → *slap*; *strike*. Also, *grasp* and *seize* (spread the hand over an object in taking possession of it).
索持也。一曰至也。从手尃聲。
推擣也。从手茸聲。
As per 旁# (spread to/be on both sides) + 手 hand/action indicator → *pole*/row a boat, switching back and forth between each side → *beat* (← beat a pole into a river bottom).
掩也。从手㫄聲。
As per 差# (irregular) + 手 hand/action indicator → roll/rub an object in smoothing out irregularities → *roll/rub between the hands*.
蚤# scratch + 手 hand/action indicator → *scratch* (with one's nails) → *rake*; *emphatic prefix*.
括也。从手蚤聲。

䍃# is 肉 flesh + 缶 bulging earthenware jug/vase → wavering motion of hands kneading meat in a vessel. 搖 adds 手 hand/action indicator → *waver*; *tremble*; *shake*; *swing*; *sway*; *flicker*; *rock* → *jolt*; *shock*; *tremor*; *vibration*; *undermine*.
動也。从手䍃聲。
As per 島# (project) + 手 hand/action indicator → *pound* projecting/protruding objects (such as hulls).
As per 叟# (search) + 手 hand/action indicator (for emphasis/clarification) → *search*.
As per 晉# (variant form of 晋 insert) + 手 hand/action indicator → *insert*.
插也。从手晉聲。搢紳前史皆作薦紳。
㧗也。从手烕聲。
益/益# fill/full + 手 hand/action indicator → *grip* an object tightly, filling the hand → *tighten*.
捉也。从手益聲。
As per 追# (exert downward pressure) + 手 hand/action indicator → *beat/strike* (with the fist, a mallet etc.). Compare 捶.
As per 弱# (supple) + 手 hand/action indicator → grasp a supple object → *grasp*; *take in hand* (compare 扭) → *hold down* → *seize*; *bind*; *arrest*.
按也。从手弱聲。
The right-hand element# described in 榻 (press flat) + 手 hand/action indicator → press in rubbing a *copy* of an inscription → *rub* (in copying). For rubbings, compare 帖 and 摺.
As per 唐# (rise) + 手 hand/action indicator → raise/rise to *block* or *block up/off*.
搫擭，不正也。从手般聲。
般# carry/transport + 手 hand/action indicator → *carry*; *transport*. 搬 was devised to replace 般 after 般 acquired its extended meanings.

荅# (press/fit together) + 手 hand/action indicator → press tightly together in raising/being raised upon or into something → *ride* (← riders squeezed together on top of an animal, or passengers packed into a vehicle).
捾也。从手舀聲。《周書》曰：“師乃搯。”搯者，拔兵刃以習擊刺。《詩》曰：“左旋右搯。”
As per 骨# (circulate) + 手 hand/action indicator → *dig* a round hole → *disturb* (← alter a situation ← dig a hole).
掘也。从手骨聲。
擖也。从手害聲。
As per the upper element# of 寒 (raise in layers) + 手 hand/action indicator → *raise*. Also, *pull up/out*.
没也。从手𥁕聲。
As per 倉# (pile) + 手 hand/action indicator → pile plundered goods → *plunder*. Compare 贓. *Thrust/poke* is a borrowed meaning.
把也。从手鬲聲。
攜 is as per 雟# (carry) + 手 hand/action indicator (for emphasis/clarification) → *carry*; *bring/take along* → *participate*; *be involved/engaged in*. 隽 is a simplified form of 攜.
窄 narrow + 手 hand/action indicator → tighten narrowly in squeezing or compressing → *squeeze*; *wring*; *press*; *close tightly* → *grill/drill* (a person); *limit* (← narrow the possibilities).
蹴引也。从手宿聲。

As per 翏# (separate from a main unit) + 手 hand/action indicator → *tighten* objects that had been separate into a single unit (compare 勠 and 繆) → *tie into a bundle* → *strangle*. Also, *be entangled*.
縛殺也。从手翏聲。
As per 國# (enclosure) + 手 hand/action indicator → *grasp*/enclose an object in the hand → *slap*.
As per 率# (compact) + 手 hand/action indicator → compact an object by throwing it (or letting it fall) to the ground → *fall*. Compare and contrast 捽.
撮取也。从手帶聲。讀若《詩》曰“螮蝀在東”。

As per 啇# (variant of 啻) (unify) + 手 hand/action indicator → create a single unit in plucking by bringing the fingertips together → *pick*; *pluck* (out); *nip* → *gather* (← gather picked fruit etc.). Compare 採.
拓果樹實也。从手啻聲。一曰指近之也。
舒也。从手离聲。
習也。从手貫聲。《春秋傳》曰：“摜瀆鬼神。”
As per 婁# (drag slaves) + 手 hand/action indicator → *pull* (a person along) → *embrace* by pulling a person toward oneself.
曳、聚也。从手婁聲。
滌也。从手旣聲。《詩》曰：“摡之釜鬵。”
橫大也。从手瓠聲。
As per 崔# (squat) + 手 hand/action indicator → *crush*/*smash*/*break* in making squat (compare 挫). Also, *stretch* (to the point of causing destruction/harm).
擠也。从手崔聲。一曰挏也，一曰折也。
As per 麻# (rub and scrape) + 手 hand/action indicator → *rub* (off); *scrape* → *stroke*; *polish*.
研也。从手麻聲。
中擊也。从手竟聲。
As per 庶# (pile) + 手 hand/action indicator → *pick up/gather* various objects and pile them.
執# seize + 手 hand/action indicator (for emphasis/clarification) → *seize*. *Attentiveness* and *gift/present* are borrowed meanings.
握持也。从手从執。
暫也。从手斬聲。

As per 區# (curve/bend) + 手 hand/action indicator → bend the fingers and lift an object → *raise the hem of one's garment* (compare 褰). Also, *search for* (← thrust one's fingers into a deep recess and bend them in looking for something).
繑也。一曰摳衣升堂。从手區聲。
舒也。又，摴蒲，戲也。从手雩聲。
捎也。从手戚聲。
As per 專# (round and/or rotating object) + 手 hand/action indicator → *roll in the hand(s)*; *roll into a ball-shape* → *collect* (← collection of threads or other objects rolled into a ball).
圜也。从手專聲。
拘擊也。从手巢聲。

As per 莫# (concealed) + 手 hand/action indicator → run the hand gently over a dimly visible object gently to determine its nature (compare 撫 and 捫) → *stroke*; *search for* → *caress*. Also, *imitate* and *copy* (← imitate brushstrokes and create a copy of a text ← stroke).
規也。从手莫聲。
As per 習# (press flat) + 手 hand/action indicator → *fold*/*rub* in pressing/flattening one thing upon another → *print* (← rubbings). For rubbings, compare 帖 and 搨.
敗也。从手習聲。

摺.explanation: 摺 is used for folding/pleating in some traditional writing; 折 meaning break, discount, etc., remains 折.
摺.example: 折叠 → 摺疊 (regional usage); 折断 → 折斷
摺.usageCaveat: Traditional usage varies regionally; 折疊 is also seen.
摺.evidenceScope: Targeted review of individual relationships against 2013 通用规范汉字表 Appendix 1; not a comprehensive audit of every Unihan pair.

entries.text: 擣頭也。从手堅聲。讀若“鏗尔舍瑟而作”。
As per 票# (rise) + 手 hand/action indicator → raise the hand (then *strike*) → *cut/mow down*.
擊也。从手票聲。一曰挈門壯也。
从手有所把也。从手厥聲。
別也。一曰擊也。从手敝聲。
As per 勞# (stoop) + 手 hand/action indicator → stoop in dredging, or in dragging a seine → *dredge*; *drag*; *fish up*.
舉手下手也。从手壹聲。
牚# prop; support + 手 hand/action indicator → *prop/support* (v.).
散# scatter + 手 hand/action indicator → *scatter* → *sprinkle*; *give someone the slip*.
As per 堯# (arch/rise high) + 手 hand/action indicator → *bend* a tall object (into a particular form) → *disarrange*; *disturb* (← bend an object out of its original shape). For disturb, compare 鐃.
擾也。从手堯聲。一曰捄也。
斯# split + 手 hand/action indicator → *rip*; *break*; *tear*.
As per 尊# (settle) + 手 hand/action indicator → settle a matter → *exercise restraint*. 撙 is effectively a variant form of 遵.
執也。从手然聲。一曰蹂也。
As per 爲# (brandish) + 手 hand/action indicator → brandish (an object) → *gesture*; *beckon*. For the idea of "brandish," compare 揮.
裂也。从手爲聲。一曰手指也。
As per 童# (run through) + 手 hand/action indicator → *strike* (as though to run through an object) → *collide* (compare 衝); *charge through*; *plow ahead*.
卂擣也。从手童聲。
喬# tall and limber + 手 hand/action indicator → *roll up*/*raise* a supple object (such as a blind/shade etc.). *Correct* is a borrowed meaning, via 矯.
舉手也。从手喬聲。一曰撟，擅也。
探也。从手覃聲。
提持也。从手單聲。讀若行遟驒驒。
As per the right-hand element# of 徹 (pass through) + 手 hand/action indicator → *remove* obstacles, allowing easy passage → *withdraw*.

As per 發# (split away in being released) + 手 hand/action indicator (for emphasis/clarification) → push/set objects aside → *push aside*; *set aside* *release* → *allocate* → *spring* (outward/upwards; compare 孛); *separate* (← become separated as a result of being released) → *eliminate*; *reject* (← separate those chosen from those not). Also, *plectrum*.
治也。从手發聲。

尞 as described in 僚, here an abbreviated form# of 繚 (raise threads and wrap them about an object) + 手 hand/action indicator → * raise*; *lift*. Also, *make orderly*, likely connected with the disentangling of threads.
理也。从手尞聲。
As per 無# (concealed) + 手 hand/action indicator → run the hand gently over a concealed object to determine its nature (compare 摸) → *stroke*; *pat*; *smooth down* → *comfort*; *calm* (v.).
安也。从手無聲。一曰循也。
As per 番# (spread seeds) + 手 hand/action indicator → *sow*, *spread* or *scatter* (seeds). There is a disconnect between the Old Chinese and more recent pronunciations of this term.
穜也。一曰布也。从手番聲。
As per 最# (take a pinch) + 手 hand/action indicator → *grasp*; *pinch*; *take* (a photo) → *film* (a movie). 撮 was devised to express the original sense of 最 after 最 came to refer to extremes.
四圭也。一曰兩指撮也。从手最聲。

As per 巽# (arrange in formation) + 手 hand/action indicator → collect and arrange (writings) → *compile* writings → *write*; *compose* (← write/compose for compilation). *Select* is a borrowed meaning via 選.
As per 菐# as described in 僕 (rough) + 手 hand/action indicator → *strike* roughly.
挨也。从手菐聲。
達# proceed smoothly + 手 hand/action indicator → *whip* sheep in urging them forward → *flog*.
鄉飲酒，罰不敬，撻其背。从手達聲。
As per 感# (shut off sensation) + 手 hand/action indicator → *shake* a person/creature insensate → *move*.

As per 僉# (assemble) + 手 hand/action indicator → assemble and arrange objects → *pick up and arrange* → *inspect* (← inspect what has been arranged; compare 檢 and 驗). Also, *fold the arms* (← arrange the arms).
拱也。从手僉聲。

雝 combines 邕 moated village + 隹 short, squat bird → birds contained in a marsh adjacent to a moated village. 擁 combines 手 hand/action indicator + 雍#, originally a variant of 雝 → contain a bird, whether in a cage or by wrapping the hands around it → *hold*; *embrace*; *protect*.
雷# thunder + 手 hand/action indicator → *beat*/*strike* loudly, like claps of thunder → *rub*; *grind*.
As per 亶# (long and flat) + 手 hand/action indicator → flatten → *monopolize*; *act arbitrarily*; *selfish* (← flatten the will/interests of others) → *self-indulgent*.
專也。从手亶聲。
As per 睪# (pick out) + 手 hand/action indicator → *pick out*; *select*; *choose* → *classify*.
柬選也。从手睪聲。
The top element# is a variant of 毄 hit. 擊 adds 手 hand/action indicator → *hit*; *strike* → *attack*; *shoot/fire* (a gun).
攴也。从手毄聲。
As per 當# (fit together) + 手 hand/action indicator → *hold to/against* in obstructing another person's progress → *block*; *stop*.

喿 is 木 tree/wood + 口 mouth (tripled) → chicks chirping in a nest in a tree (compare 巣 and 集). 操 is as per 喿# (activity taking place above) + 手 hand/action indicator → *manipulate* or *operate* (from above) → *manage*; *pull strings* → *chastity*; *fidelity* (← manners that enable the smooth manipulation of human relations). Also, *puppet* and *marionette* (← figures manipulated by pulling strings).
把持也。从手喿聲。
As per 敬# (stiff; upright) + 手 hand/action indicator → raise an object high and upright with both hands → *raise high with both hands* (compare 與).

As per 睘# as described in 環 (circular) + 手 hand/action indicator → thrust the arms through an object (a garment, armor etc.) then wrap it about oneself → *thrust through*; *penetrate*. For the idea of penetrating, compare 貫.
貫也。从手瞏聲。《春秋傳》曰：“擐甲執兵。”
禽# capture + 手 hand/action indicator → *capture* → *seize*; *captive*. 擒 was devised to replace 禽 after the latter came to refer primarily to the birds and animals captured.
As per 詹# (bear a burden) + 手 hand/action indicator → *shoulder a load*; *load*; *bear*; *undertake*.
刮也。从手葛聲。一曰撻也。
Effectively a variant form of 擘 (tear/rip an object apart/open, spreading its contents) → *split*; *rend* → *beat the breast* (← rend one's garments).

As per 辟# (spread) + 手 hand/action indicator → tear/rip an an object open/apart, spreading its contents → *rip/tear open*. Also, *stretch a bowstring*. *Thumb* is via reinterpretation of the elements of the character as "the digit of the hand spread away from the other digits."
撝也。从手辟聲。
As per 豦# as described in 劇 (fierce) + 手 hand/action indicator → fierce martial activity resulting in occupation of an enemy position → *base* → *point of origin*.
杖持也。从手豦聲。
As per 齊# (align) + 手 hand/action indicator → align tightly by pushing, pressing or squeezing together → *push*; *press*; *squeeze* → *push/thrust aside*.
排也。从手齊聲。
As per 臺# (rise high) + 手 hand/action indicator → *raise/lift* → *carry* (high). Compare 舁.
As per 翟# (rise high) + 手 hand/action indicator → raise objects high then *select* from among them → *pull up/out*; *surpass*; *pick out* → *excel* (← select objects of surpassing quality).
引也。从手翟聲。
壽# long span + 手 hand/action indicator → *pound* or *beat* at length → *attack* (an enemy unexpectedly).
手推也。一曰築也。从手𠷎聲。
An abbreviated form# of 鼽 (nasal obstruction) + 手 hand/action indicator → (use the hands/fingers to) *blow the nose*.

As per 察# (rub spotless) + 手 hand/action indicator → *rub* spotless → *chafe*; *rustle*. Also, *run through* (one's money) (← be reduced to threadbare clothes) → *become worldly-wise*. 擦 was devised to replace 察 after the latter's transformation of meanings.

As per 與# (raise in unison) + 手 hand/action indicator (for emphasis/clarification) → *raise*; *action*; *pick up*; *do/perform*; *all/all together*; *in a body*. Also, *indicate* and *demonstrate* (← raise significant points), along with *nominate*, *arrest* and *hold* (a ceremony) (← group actions).
對舉也。从手與聲。
染也。从手需聲。《周禮》：“六曰擩祭。”
一指按也。从手厭聲。
As per 疑 (come to a stop) + 手 hand/action indicator → bring to a stop. *Imitate*,*resemble* and *model on* are borrowed meanings.
度也。从手疑聲。
搫擭也。一曰布擭也，一曰握也。从手蒦聲。
As per 賓# (contact) + 手 hand → lay hands on someone and *expel* him → *push out/away*; *reject*.
As per 閣# (cause to stop) + 手 hand/action indicator → *catch hold of and stop* → *put/lay down*.
As per 鄭# (extend downward) + 手 hand/action indicator → *throw*/*cast* an object straight down → *throw away*. Also, *hit/punch* (← throw a punch).
As per 廣# (extend) + 手 hand/action indicator → *extend* → *enlarge*; *spread*.
As per 頡# (gather) + 手 hand/action indicator → *pick/gather up*.
理持也。从手巤聲。
As per 罷# (spread over) + 手 hand/action indicator → cause to spread over → *spread (in display)* → *push open* (to right and left); *shake/swing* (back and forth).
As per 樂# (grind/continue at length) + 手 hand/action indicator → *beat/whip continuously*. Also, *tickle*, another form of unrelenting torment.
適# suitable + 手 hand/action indicator → select suitable items (and *discard* the rest) → *reveal*; *expose* (← discard and leave revealed/exposed).
搔也。从手適聲。一曰投也。
